info.name: pdf-server
info.description:
Standalone Rust/Axum service that renders PDFs from Typst templates. **No authentication** — every route here is open, so there is no Bearer/API-key setup needed.

Base URL (and sample keys) are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment (Development/Production) to point requests at the right instance.

**Phase 3 status**: `Render`, `Templates`, and `Documents` are all fully real now — every module has dropped its module-status stub in favor of a real collection-root endpoint.

**Getting real template keys**: the seed `receipt`/`sticker` templates are created automatically the first time the server starts (see `templates/receipt.typ`/`templates/sticker.typ`). Easiest path: run `Templates > List Templates` and copy the `key` values from the response into the environment's `templateKey`/`stickerKey` variables. (Or read them directly from SQLite: `sqlite3 pdf_server.db "SELECT key, name FROM templates;"`.)

**Getting a real document key**: run `Render > Render Receipt` or `Render > Render Sticker` once, then `Documents > List Documents` and copy a `key` into the environment's `documentKey` variable — or read `sqlite3 pdf_server.db "SELECT key FROM documents;"` directly.

request.description: Liveness check — always returns 200 if the process is up and able to handle a request at all. Doesn't touch SQLite or the render engine, so it can't distinguish "server up, database down".
Trivial "is this module wired up" check — not a health/readiness probe.

Compiles the `receipt` template (see `templates/receipt.typ`'s header comment for its full JSON contract) against this request body and returns the rendered PDF as raw bytes — `Content-Type: application/pdf`, **not** the usual `{success, data, message}` envelope every other endpoint in this collection uses. Postman will offer to preview or save the response as a PDF.

Errors still go through the standard envelope: 404 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown/inactive `{{templateKey}}`, 422 `RENDER_VALIDATION_FAILED` if the body doesn't satisfy the template's data contract, 500 `PDF_EXPORT_FAILED` on export failure.

Compiles the `sticker` template (see `templates/sticker.typ`'s header comment) — a 50mm×30mm print label with a Code128 barcode and a QR code (both encoding `reference`), generated by the vendored `tiaoma`/`zebra` Typst packages under `templates/lib/`. Same response shape and error codes as Render Receipt — raw PDF bytes on success, the standard envelope on 404/422/500.
Lists every template's metadata (both active and inactive), sorted by name. Use this to find the real `key` values for `{{templateKey}}`/`{{stickerKey}}` on a fresh instance.

Fetch one template's metadata/data-contract by `key`. 404 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` if the key doesn't exist (this does *not* filter on `isActive` the way rendering does — an inactive template's metadata is still fetchable here).
Lists every recorded document (one row per successful render, written by `Render Receipt`/`Render Sticker`), newest first. Use this to find a real `key` for `{{documentKey}}`.

Fetch one document's record by `key` — the template it was rendered from (`templateKey`), the exact JSON `data` it was rendered with, and `fileSizeBytes`. Does **not** return the PDF itself (no PDF bytes are stored — see Reprint Document for that). 404 `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` if the key doesn't exist.

Re-renders this document's stored `data` against the template and returns raw PDF bytes — `Content-Type: application/pdf`, same binary-response deviation as Render Receipt/Render Sticker. Not a cached copy of the original PDF (none is stored): this recompiles, so a template fix made *and the server restarted* since the original render shows up here too — see CLAUDE.md's "Documents as first-class resources" section for the exact boundary (recompiles against the template as of the server's last startup, not literally live disk edits).

404 `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` if the key doesn't exist; 422/500 in the same shape as rendering, if the stored data somehow no longer satisfies the (possibly since-changed) template.
